notablePrerequisites:
Curiosity attached to Brallin.
You have a number of cards in hand greater than your maximum hand size.
description:
During your cleanup step, discard to your maximum hand size.
Brallin triggers for each card discarded, getting a +1/+1 counter and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Curiosity triggers, causing you to draw a card for each damage dealt.
Pass priority, moving to an additional cleanup step.
Repeat until you have no cards left in library or have won the game.
